findings.title: Shipped code is a stripped demo (nsim<-5, single condition) that does not, as-shipped, reproduce the manuscript tables
findings.description: The OSF R script (xrq3k) is available and runs, but hardcodes nsim<-5 and a single mean configuration (7-group non-null, n=100); the other 11 configs are comment-blocked. Running it as-is yields one nsim=5 row, not the manuscript's Tables 3-8. Reprogramming nsim to 5000 and looping the 12 configs (108 conditions) is required to reproduce the tables; we verified the logic is correct when scaled (live nsim=500 run reproduced the flagship Table 6/8 n100 cells within MC noise).
findings.evidence: hunter_author_sim.R:13 'nsim<-5'; lines 24-33 comment-blocked configs; lines 379-380 print partial results. Live run status 0.
findings.impact: Medium - primary simulation code present but under-configured; full reproduction requires user edits.
findings.fix: Ship the script with nsim<-5000 and an explicit loop over all 12 mean-structure x n configurations, plus a stated seed.

findings.title: meta_vard replication-variance columns are swapped (rep1/rep2)
findings.description: In the author code the replication-study variances for the FE meta-analysis are written to the wrong matrix columns: rep1 variance is stored at k+npair*2 and rep2 variance at k+npair (lines 117-125), instead of k+npair and k+npair*2. meta_d (the effect sizes) uses the correct mapping. Net effect on the fixed-effect meta p-values is negligible at typical conditions (n100 meta cells reproduced: .993 vs .994), but it is a latent defect affecting the small-n meta cells.
findings.evidence: hunter_author_sim.R lines 117-125; compare with correct meta_d mapping lines 108-116.
findings.impact: Low - did not change headline conclusions; small-n meta cells show up to ~0.05 deviation.
findings.fix: Correct the variance column indices (k+npair and k+npair*2) to match meta_d.

findings.title: No random seed set or reported
findings.description: The author code contains no set.seed() and the paper does not report one; R uses the default RNG. Because nsim=5000 per condition, MC sampling error is ~0.006 and our cross-seed drift test (20260914 vs 987654321) showed FWER cells stable to <=0.005.
findings.evidence: No seed string in hunter_author_sim.R or paper_extracted.txt; drift values in output/drift_seed2_fwer_4groups.rds.
findings.impact: Low - seed-stable results; exact bit-for-bit reproduction of table decimals not guaranteed.
findings.fix: Add set.seed() to the script and report it in supplementary materials.

findings.title: Author code is computationally impractical for full reproduction (in-loop metafor::rma)
findings.description: The author script calls metafor::rma inside the per-simulation loop; a single condition at nsim=500 took ~355 s and nsim=2000 exceeded 900 s. Scaling to nsim=5000 x 108 conditions would take on the order of days. The independent base-R reimplementation reproduced all 12 configs x 5000 sims in 205 s.
findings.evidence: Live runs: nsim500 elapsed 355.2 s; nsim2000 exceeded 900 s (aborted).
findings.impact: Low for the manuscript numbers themselves (already computed), but a real barrier to any re-runner; flagged as efficiency/hygiene.
findings.fix: Vectorize or precompute the meta p-values (closed-form z on inverse-variance weighted d) outside the simulation loop.

findings.title: No archived reproduction log/output for 'Analysis reproduced by: Erin M. Buchanan'
findings.description: The 'Analysis reproduced by' badge is consistent with our independent reproduction of the simulation, but OSF contains no archived reproduction record (log, output, or script variant) that would let a reader witness the editor's run.
findings.evidence: OSF Submission component contains only cover letter, R script, author manuscript PDF; no output/CSV/log files.
findings.impact: Low - claim is plausible and independently corroborated here; hygiene/archival gap.
findings.fix: Archive the reproduction log and output tables alongside the code.
